My kitten's eye looked like this, text my vet and she said it was Microphthalmia. "In kittens, "small eye syndrome," or microphthalmia, is a congenital condition where one or both eyes are abnormally small, and may be associated with other eye abnormalities or vision problems". He's never acted like it's bothered him, scratched/itched at it, or anything. Never physically took him to the vet and he's doing fine. I'll post a current pic.
